args.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, and this fallback is being used in production, causing password reset (and other) email links to point at localhost instead of the real public URL.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL is always set in the production environment/deployment configuration, and/or make the fallback fail loudly (e.g. throw or log an error) in non-development environments instead of silently defaulting to localhost, so misconfiguration is caught before emails are sent. This affects passwordResetEmail, rollupText, and scheduledExportEmail, all of which rely on BASE_URL.
